vectors.note: Stand-in for the capture-derived Kotlin "full night" test. dayIndex 1 = the wake day is yesterday; first record 22:50 > last 06:45 so the night starts the evening before. The [1,25,0] record (hour 25) is skipped. The 20-minute wake at 03:10 stays inside the bout.
